title: Reducing Non-Normative Text Generation from Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating text continuations from story corpora prompts and measuring the proportion of descriptions violating social norms using an automated normative text classifier (trained on Goofus & Gallant comics) and human participant evaluations.
Prompting the language model with specific demographic keywords (e.g., "asian" and "black") and measuring the frequency at which the model generates toxic language continuations.
Classifying generated text using fine-tuned BERT classifiers and SentiWordNet to evaluate the proportion of toxic language and negative sentiment in the model outputs.
